name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce automation: standard/custom object CRUD, SOQL/SOSL query, and Tooling API metadata operations

document.name: List Available Objects
document.description: Lists the standard and custom objects available in the org.

a1a1.name: describeGlobal
a1a1.description: Lists the standard and custom objects available in the org.

document.name: Get Object Basic Information
document.description: Returns basic metadata and related resource URLs for a given object.

a1a1.name: getSObjectBasicInfo
a1a1.description: Returns basic metadata and related resource URLs for a given object.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

document.name: Describe Object
document.description: Returns full field-level metadata for a given object.

a1a1.name: describeSObject
a1a1.description: Returns full field-level metadata for a given object.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

document.name: Create Record
document.description: Creates a new record of the given sObject type.

a1a1.name: createRecord
a1a1.description: Creates a new record of the given sObject type.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

document.name: Get Record
document.description: Retrieves field values for a record by ID.

a1a1.name: getRecord
a1a1.description: Retrieves field values for a record by ID.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return; omit to return all accessible fields

document.name: Update Record
document.description: Updates field values on an existing record by ID.

a1a1.name: updateRecord
a1a1.description: Updates field values on an existing record by ID.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)
API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

document.name: Upsert Record by External ID
document.description: Creates or updates a record identified by an External ID field.

a1a1.name: upsertRecordByExternalId
a1a1.description: Creates or updates a record identified by an External ID field.

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)

externalIdFieldName.description: API name of the field marked as an External ID on this object

externalIdFieldValue.description: Value of the external ID field identifying the record to upsert

document.name: SOQL Query
document.description: Executes a SOQL query and returns matching records.

a1a1.name: query
a1a1.description: Executes a SOQL query and returns matching records.

document.name: SOQL Query All
document.description: Executes a SOQL query, including archived and deleted records in the results.

a1a1.name: queryAll
a1a1.description: Executes a SOQL query, including archived and deleted records in the results.

document.name: SOSL Search
document.description: Executes a SOSL search across one or more object types.

a1a1.name: search
a1a1.description: Executes a SOSL search across one or more object types.

q.description: SOSL search string, e.g. FIND {Acme} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)

document.name: List Tooling Objects

a1a1.description: Lists the metadata objects exposed through the Tooling API.

a1a1.description: Creates a new record of the given Tooling API object type (e.g. CustomField, ValidationRule).

sObjectName.description: API name of the standard or custom Salesforce object (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead)
